steps.name: Place of Trust (1)
steps.objective: After talking to [Rosemary] in "Mars", go to [Zis Card] in "Zisk Territory".

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Aren't you done here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I just wanted to come back one more time. I was wondering if there was anything else going on... .

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: It's already a mess, but it gets even more so when you come and go.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is it because of the mayor’s job?

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Right. Even if Peonia posts a notice and explains it, they don't really believe it. There is also a story that says Peonia is in league with the mayor.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Someone will be sent from the Union of Light soon. Peonia made a request, but the funny thing is that people who didn't trust Peonia's words step down when someone from Luman comes.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: The people who have been doing Mars' work so far are people who don't even know who they are... .

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Well, it will work out somehow.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see. Then I… .

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: You. Do you have any good maps?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There are no good maps.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Jude Kingdom humans, this is what they show you as a good map. The center of the continent is not shown at all.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Should we also lend a hand to the Union of Light? In fact, the best information on this continent is in Luman... .

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: I'm sorry, but please go to Luman. I have to keep checking Avalon's trends. Moreover, Demigod humans... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You're busy. Then I will help you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Any map that shows the center of the continent well will do, right?

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Yeah. I heard that Jiscard is at Lumen these days? Then go ahead and ask. I will tell the church that the goddess' errand boy helped them.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: The church will give you some compensation. It would be nice if I didn't have to suffer... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's okay. Then I'll come back.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Is Jiscard in the territory now?)

steps.name: Place of Trust (2)
steps.objective: Defeat [Lethe of Oblivion] at “Lake of Oblivion” and obtain <Howl Kingdom Map>. Then report to [Rosemary] in “Mars”.

lines.text: (As soon as you enter Jisk territory, the animals are so shocked that they disappear.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You were there too.)

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Hey, are you here? But what happened? Is it because of L’s work?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes? What happened to El?

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: No, I'm just taking a break. He looked tired so I told him to rest.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's it. I'm glad you're okay.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: That's right. By the way, tell me you didn't just come here. What's going on?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yeah, that's... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tell Jiscard about Rosemary and tell him you came to get a good map.)

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: The Battlelord is still in Eastland. When you see that the Demigods are nowhere to be seen... . hmm… .

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: After you visited, books from Howl's kingdom were discovered near the lakeside. I think there are some things missing... . perhaps… .

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Maybe you can find it. What is it like? Would you like to go?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I will give it a try. By the lake... .

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Does what Lethe said matter?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yeah, a little… .

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Never mind. If you think about it too complicated, it won't work.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll keep that in mind. And then… .

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Mediah, things will go well, so don't worry too much.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, when Jiscard said that, my frustration was relieved.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Medea will call you later when the time comes, so just wait. And the lakeside is a dangerous place even if Lethe disappears, so be careful... .

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: I will look into Baral, so there is no need for you to look into it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I understand.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Yes, always be careful... .

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Demigod Velosh... .
(Rosemary tears the letter she was holding into pieces.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Rosemary, I'm here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I guess he heard the news about Demigod because he looks so angry.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: The church sent me a letter. The seal wasn't anything special, so I just looked at it... .

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: It's a bit annoying!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is it about?

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Velosh is gone. It has now become clear that something happened to him.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: I thought Weiss' attack was simply a sacred power seal. But, my mind had collapsed.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (...Is this the effect of bondage?)

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: The church held on to him, prayed for him, and continued to provide healing training, but he said he had a hard time because he kept trying to escape.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Even without power, Demigod is Demigod... . They say he defeated everyone and disappeared. He's gone missing.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you trying to get revenge?

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: It's possible with Velosh. Although he follows God, he has strong pride and is arrogant in unnecessary ways.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: That's why the calm Frozen sometimes gets annoyed.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Well, you'll take care of it. You will accept the results yourself.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Damn… . Stupid human… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, I'll give you a map.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Wow, this is a really great map. Howl’s Kingdom? It used to be the largest kingdom in Eastland... . With this map, we can get closer to Avalon.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Thank you. Thanks to you, I think I can do well.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: The church will give you a reward, but I will also give you one in my own way. That's good information. Listen carefully.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Are you interested in trusts?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A trust?

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Yes, oracle. A message from God.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: A message from God came to the church not long ago. To be exact, it told me the day I received the oracle.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: You can go through Iris without going anywhere, but Iris is also incomplete, so… .

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Iris I'm not trying to offend you, so just filter it out.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (...It's really interesting that he's a battle lord who despises God.)

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Trusts usually appear in various forms, but first they come with something like a notice. Where and how will I send the message, things like that.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: It would be one of the places usually considered sacred... .

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: This time, it wasn't the temple of the Church of Ceres. What are you talking about behind the message? What are you talking about? .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If… .

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: If you are interested in my story, gather information. Iris I told you this because I thought it would be helpful if you are directly connected to him.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Hehe, aren’t you thankful?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It was helpful. Thank you, Rosemary.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Ugh, don’t say thank you with that look on your face. Don’t look at me with an expression similar to Frozen!!

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: It's hard to get used to it because you've changed a lot in the time I haven't seen you. Phew… . But who are those people? These are people I’ve never seen in Phobos.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Those are Raclette and Zelic….)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Obviously we made eye contact... Wait, where did these people go?)

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Ah, that's it. I want to rest. Wow, this is annoying. What do you want to do? Would you like to have a drink together?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No. I was thinking of a place to go.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Yeah? Then there is nothing we can do.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Rosemary, how are you? See you next time then.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Yeah... . I'll see you next time when I'm not really doing anything.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Raclette and Zelic... I think they were sent by Dayna. Should I go to Esnil and ask Dayna? It's definitely not an ordinary thing. An oracle, the other side... It's too obvious, though.)

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Of course, the timing... .

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Ahahaha, Mr. %s. Welcome.
(Dana greets you with an awkward smile, as if embarrassed.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Dana, this is suspicious.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Since I knew this, I won’t deny it. Now, come and sit here.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Do you want some tea? For dessert, choose whatever you want from what is there. Zelic gave me a lot today too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Come to think of it, tomorrow is the day Zelic's new work comes out? Around this time, an elf wizard named Soreyu always comes and waits.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, I heard that Soreille likes desserts.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: After all, you are also friends with that wizard. Oh, sorry. The voice fairy fell into thin air.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is a voice fairy?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: %s doesn't know. If the story deviates from the topic or becomes too long, we use this expression in Playos.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: By the way, you saw Raclette and Zelic in Mars, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What happened?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: It’s nothing special… . I had some business in the area near Phobos, so I sent it to check. It's nothing big.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: We thought %s left Mars. So even though I saw it, I think I just pretended not to notice.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Since I was working, there was nothing I could do about it.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Thank you for trusting me. So, did you receive your sister’s edict?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You know. I received it, but it's not time yet.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Looks like we have some time left. Then may I tell you one thing? I think it's pretty good information... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Of course.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: It may be helpful to recognize that you need to organize your thoughts while waiting.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: We recently found traces of someone trying to connect the demon world with this world.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: It's a place with great energy behind it. Maybe it could be the place my sister points out.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … Where is it?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: It's an area named Eidos. People often call it ‘sanctuary’. It is also where the Holy Knights stay.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: It looks like you want me to tell you a little more.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Actually, I don't know either. That's all I know. If you were my sister, you could use your foresight to know what will happen and how... .

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: I don't know if your body will hold up... .

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Oh no. %s, you didn't hear this. It seems like I'm worried about my sister.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay, so… . Maybe I'll go to the sanctuary next time. But how do I get to the sanctuary?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: … Hmm, I don't know about that.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It can't be helped.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Dana kindly tells me everything.)

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: There are only a few days left, right? The day I open my sister’s royal decree… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, we have to go to the Valley of the Dragon then.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Then, until then, rest well.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Just saying thank you. Then I will go back.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Aren’t you curious about anything else?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will slowly learn about things that haven't happened yet.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Hehe.
(Dana shows a meaningful smile.)

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Thank you, Mr. %s.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Bye then.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, Dana is doing well too.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: I guess that's why everyone likes it. My sister is like that, and so is Shiina.
